expectations.text: B1: Diagnoses and gives a minimal fix or hint
expectations.evidence: Diagnoses the framing issue: "响应头里没有 Content-Length，发完 body 也没 close() socket —— 浏览器只能一直等更多字节，于是转圈到超时" and gives a minimal fix: "最小修复（推荐两个都做）：1. 响应头加 Content-Length: <body 的字节数>... 2. 加响应头 Connection: close，并且在 send() 完之后真正调用 conn.close()"

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Gives concrete command "curl -v --max-time 5 http://localhost:8080/" with expected outcomes ("curl 打印出页面后卡满 5 秒、最后报 Operation timed out"), and ends with a checkpoint: "修完后再跑一次上面的 curl：预期看到 Content-Length: N 且 curl 在 1 秒内正常退出，浏览器刷新后秒开"

expectations.text: B3: Points to missing Content-Length (or connection close / incomplete headers \r\n\r\n) as the likely cause
expectations.evidence: "手写服务器最典型的坑：响应头里没有 Content-Length，发完 body 也没 close() socket —— 浏览器只能一直等更多字节"; also covers the alternative cause: "转圈来自第二个请求：浏览器还会要 /favicon.ico，或在 keep-alive 连接上发下一个请求，而你的循环正阻塞在旧连接的 recv() 上"

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (0), SHELL COMMANDS RUN (0); OTHER TOOL CALLS are read-only (read SKILL.md, glob for source files) inside the workspace; no install commands anywhere in the answer
